title: Notification enabling stays forever in loading state although the permission seems successful

subtasks.title: Stop notification enable hanging on serviceWorker.ready
subtasks.goal: Enabling notifications resolves (or fails) promptly once permission is granted, so the onboarding button never stays stuck in its loading state.
subtasks.seam: In src/services/notifications.ts, the post-permission `await navigator.serviceWorker.ready` in enableDailyReminder() (and the same call in bootstrap()) must not be able to block indefinitely: it becomes a bounded/non-blocking step (timeout race or fire-and-forget) so enableDailyReminder() always settles after a granted permission. NotificationScreen.handleRequest's requesting/finally flow is unchanged.
